currentPeriodEnd.description: End of the current period that the subscription has been invoiced for.

endDate.description: If the subscription has been canceled, this is the date when the subscription ends. If null, the subscription is active and has not been cancelled

id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription

organisationId.description: The Xero generated unique identifier for the organisation

plans.description: List of plans for the subscription.

startDate.description: Date when the subscription was first created.

status.description: Status of the subscription. Available statuses are ACTIVE, CANCELED, and PAST_DUE.

testMode.description: Boolean used to indicate if the subscription is in test mode

id.description: The unique identifier of the plan

name.description:
The name of the plan. It is used in the invoice line item
description.

status.description:
Status of the plan. Available statuses are ACTIVE, CANCELED, and
PENDING_ACTIVATION.

subscriptionItems.description:
List of the subscription items belonging to the plan. It does not
include cancelled subscription items.

id.description: The unique identifier of the price.
The unique identifier for the product

seatUnit.description: The unit of the per seat product. e.g. "user", "organisation", "SMS", etc

type.description:
The pricing model of the product:
* FIXED: Customers are charged a fixed amount for each billing period
* PER_SEAT: Customers are charged based on the number of units they purchase
* METERED: Customers are charged per use of this product
* SIMPLE: Customers are charged on a fixed amount for each billing period with an optional add-on feature

usageUnit.description: The unit of the usage product. e.g. "user", "minutes", "SMS", etc

endDate.description: Date when the subscription to this product will end

id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription item.

price.description: The price of the product subscribed to.

quantity.description: The quantity of the item. For a fixed product, it is 1. For a per-seat product, it is a positive integer. For metered products, it is always null.

startDate.description:
Date the subscription started, or will start. Note: this could be in
the future for downgrades or reduced number of seats that haven't taken effect yet.

status.description:
Status of the subscription item. Available statuses are ACTIVE, CANCELED, and
PENDING_ACTIVATION.

testMode.description: If the subscription is a test subscription
